source_issues.detail: src_1 (AoPS wiki IMO 2022 P6) and src_2 (Evan Chen IMO 2022 notes) are declared 'context only' and no step of the proof depends on them; they were not retrieved (no browsing available) and need not be, since the proof is self-contained. src_3 is an internal repo file whose lemmas are re-proved in §0.

computation_issues.detail: Trusted orchestrator re-runs: code_2 -> 1377 independent 12-sets containing 0, 27540 pairs, 0 acyclic complements (0.44s); code_3 (no symmetry, different enumeration and different acyclicity test) -> 3672 sets, 73440 pairs, 0 acyclic complements (0.77s); code_4 and code_5 (recursion vs explicit DFS, no shared code) both -> 88 with identical 8 valleys, and code_4's printed order matches the §4 labelling verbatim. All integer arithmetic; counts consistent (3672*12/32 = 1377). The computed statement (★) is exactly what §2 reduces T<=87 to, including Structure A via I=P\{u0}, u=u0. Symmetry reduction (XOR translations, vertex-transitive, (★) automorphism-invariant) and the sole pruning rule in code_2 (insufficient remaining vertices) are valid.

code_6 (200k random labellings) and code_7 (simulated annealing, best 88 on seeds 0-7) are correctly labelled as sanity/exploration and are not used in the proof. The §5 remark that Lemmas 3-7 reproduce U(Q_4)=34 and U(Q_3)=14 is stated as a consistency check, not verified here, and does not bear on the result.
Python version is not recorded in the artifacts; the scripts use only the standard library and were reproduced by the orchestrator with python3, so this is cosmetic.

claim_provenance.notes: Upper bound 88: explicit labelling in required format, count reproduced by two independent exact scripts (trusted re-run). Lower bound 88: hand case analysis (§0-§2) reducing T<=87 to statement (★), then exhaustive exact search over all independent 12-sets (two independent implementations, one with proved symmetry reduction, one without), both reproduced by orchestrator with 0 witnesses; runtime <1s. Computer-assisted lower bound is explicitly permitted by the column rules and the code plus explanation are included.

report.reproducibility_notes: All seven artifacts re-executed by the orchestrator in a clean sandbox with exit 0 and outputs matching the submission (code_2: 1377/27540/0 in 0.44s; code_3: 3672/73440/0 in 0.77s; code_4 and code_5: 88, same valleys, same 32-string order). Certificates are stdlib-only, exact-integer, deterministic, and run in about 1 second total, far below the 10-minute limit. The submitted labelling can be independently re-checked by any uphill-path counter. No external source is required for validity.
